description: Introduce evolution BRANCHES in the shared domain layer (packages/shared) while keeping the linear tiers (baby->rookie->champion->ultimate). Representation choice: KEEP `stageId: GrowthStage` as the tier and ADD a new OPTIONAL `form?: MonsterForm` field to Monster, where MonsterForm is a string-literal union of the 3 variants: 'attack' | 'defense' | 'mischief'. Backward compat: pre-#38 saves have no `form`; it is defaulted to a canonical base form on load (base = 'attack' is NOT acceptable because it must be neutral; use a dedicated default that maps to today's stats/sprite/prompt). Implement the branch decision as a SHARED, PURE, DETERMINISTIC, TOTAL function over care tendencies, with the SAME function feeding the StatsPanel hint (FEAT-004) so UI can never contradict the real outcome. Mirror the #42 affection / #41 battleRecord optional-with-default pattern EXACTLY (formOf, normalizeForm, validateMonster accepts absent-or-known and rejects present-but-invalid). Unit-test that EVERY branch is reachable and ties/edge cases resolve deterministically. This feature is backend/frontend agnostic; it only changes packages/shared and its tests.
steps: In packages/shared/src/types.ts: add `export type MonsterForm = "base" | "attack" | "defense" | "mischief";` with a doc comment. 'base' is the canonical default form used for the baby tier and as the backward-compat default for legacy saves; 'attack'/'defense'/'mischief' are the chosen variants a monster evolves into at rookie and above. Add an OPTIONAL `form?: MonsterForm;` field to the Monster interface with a doc block MIRRORING the existing `affection?`/`battleRecord?` doc blocks (explain it is optional on legacy saves, defaulted via formOf/normalizeForm on load, and that validateMonster accepts it absent).

In packages/shared/src/stages.ts: define per-(tier,variant) baseStats and metadata. Add an exported structure, e.g. `FORM_CONFIG` or extend StageConfig, giving each non-baby tier three variant baseStats that DIFFER meaningfully: attack-type = higher atk / lower def, defense-type = higher def+hp / lower atk, mischief-type = balanced-but-quirky (e.g. slightly higher atk and hp, lowest def), all derived from the current linear baseStats so the 'base' form stays byte-identical to today's STAGES baseStats. Baby tier has only the 'base' form. Expose a helper `formBaseStats(stageId, form): Stats` that returns the variant stats, falling back to the stage's existing baseStats for 'base' or any unknown input (total function). Add short JA/EN variant labels on the shared side ONLY if needed by both backend and frontend; otherwise keep labels in frontend i18n (FEAT-004) and keep shared returning the variant KEY. Document the stat design in comments.

In packages/shared/src/game.ts: add the backward-compat helpers mirroring affection: `formOf(monster): MonsterForm` (returns monster.form if it is a known MonsterForm, else 'base'), and `normalizeForm(monster): Monster` (returns a NEW monster with form filled to formOf(monster); clone stats+careCounters like normalizeAffection; idempotent, no mutation).

In packages/shared/src/game.ts (or a new packages/shared/src/evolution.ts exported via index.ts — prefer game.ts to stay close to applyEvolution, but a dedicated module is fine): implement the branch-decision pure function `chooseEvolutionForm(monster, now): MonsterForm`. It must be DETERMINISTIC and TOTAL (always returns one of 'attack'|'defense'|'mischief' for a non-baby target tier). Decide the variant from care tendencies using existing fields: trainingCount, careCounters.feed/sleep/clean, hungryLevel and dirty (neglect signals), battle win rate derived from battleRecordOf(monster) (wins/(wins+losses+draws)), and optionally affectionOf. Suggested, documented rule: compute three scores — attackScore (training-heavy and/or high battle win rate), defenseScore (sleep-heavy, well-fed, high affection, kept clean), mischiefScore (neglect: high hungryLevel, dirty, low clean count, low affection) — and pick the max; resolve ties DETERMINISTICALLY by a fixed priority order (document it, e.g. attack > defense > mischief). Keep the scoring simple, pure, and fully covered by tests. The baby->rookie step and every later step uses this same function to pick the target form.

In packages/shared/src/game.ts: wire the chosen form into evolution. In `applyEvolution`/`applyAllEvolutions`, when advancing to a new (non-baby) tier, call chooseEvolutionForm to set monster.form, and rebase stats onto `formBaseStats(newStageId, chosenForm)` instead of the plain stage baseStats (preserve the existing HP-ratio and max-with-current atk/def behavior). The baby tier keeps form 'base'. Ensure a monster that never had `form` still works (formOf default).
In packages/shared/src/game.ts createMonster: set `form: "base"` on a fresh baby (mirroring how affection/battleRecord are initialized inline).

In packages/shared/src/game.ts validateMonster: add a backward-compat block for `form` MIRRORING the affection/battleRecord blocks — ACCEPT when form is absent/undefined/null OR a known MonsterForm string; REJECT only when present-but-invalid (not a known variant). Do NOT reject legacy saves lacking form.

In packages/shared/src/stages.ts: expose the PREDICTED next form for the UI hint without duplicating logic — add a function (e.g. `predictedNextForm(monster, now): MonsterForm | null`) that returns chooseEvolutionForm(...) when not at the final stage and the next tier is non-baby, else null. Keep evolutionProgress backward-compatible (do not remove or rename its existing fields — the existing StatsPanel/onboarding tests depend on them). If adding the predicted form to the progress snapshot, add it as a NEW field; do not change existing field names/values.
In packages/shared/src/index.ts: export the new types (MonsterForm) and helpers (formOf, normalizeForm, chooseEvolutionForm, formBaseStats, predictedNextForm) if not already surfaced via `export *`.

Adapt existing tests in packages/shared/src/__tests__/stages.test.ts: the linear-evolution assertions (evolveStage baby->rookie etc.) still hold for the TIER; keep them. Where a test asserts rebased stats equal getStage(x).baseStats, update it to account for the variant chosen by the default/forced care profile (assert against formBaseStats for the form the test's monster would pick), WITHOUT deleting the coverage. Prefer constructing monsters with a known care profile so the chosen form is predictable.

Adapt packages/shared/src/__tests__/game.property.test.ts if the one-step-evolution property or any stat invariant now depends on form (the one-step tier contract must still hold; monsterGen may need a form field or rely on the optional default).

Add a NEW test file packages/shared/src/__tests__/evolution-branching.test.ts (node:test) covering: (a) chooseEvolutionForm returns 'attack' for a training-heavy / high-win-rate monster; (b) returns 'defense' for a sleep-heavy / well-cared / high-affection monster; (c) returns 'mischief' for a neglected monster (high hunger, dirty, low clean, low affection) — PROVING all three branches are reachable; (d) determinism: the same inputs always yield the same form, and an engineered TIE resolves to the documented priority winner; (e) totality: a legacy-style monster (minimal/zeroed care) still returns a valid variant; (f) formOf defaults a legacy monster (no form) to 'base' and clamps an unknown value to 'base'; (g) normalizeForm fills 'base' for a legacy monster and is idempotent and non-mutating (mirror the normalizeAffection/normalizeBattleRecord tests); (h) validateMonster accepts a monster with form absent, accepts each known variant, and REJECTS a monster whose form is an unknown string; (i) formBaseStats returns differing stats per variant for a given tier and falls back to the stage baseStats for 'base'; (j) applyEvolution/train end-to-end: a training-heavy monster that evolves lands on form 'attack' with attack-type stats, and the 'base' stat block for a neutrally-raised monster stays byte-identical to the pre-#38 stage baseStats.
Run the shared test suite and confirm all tests pass with a higher total than the FEAT-001 baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Monster has an OPTIONAL `form?: MonsterForm` field; MonsterForm = 'base'|'attack'|'defense'|'mischief'. A pre-#38 monster (no form) validates, loads, and normalizes to 'base' with its stats/stage unaffected.

chooseEvolutionForm is pure, deterministic, and total; unit tests prove every one of the three evolvable branches ('attack','defense','mischief') is reachable and that an engineered tie resolves to the documented priority order.
formOf/normalizeForm/validateMonster mirror the #42/#41 optional-with-default pattern (default 'base', accept-absent-or-valid, reject present-but-invalid), with tests.
Per-variant baseStats differ meaningfully (attack vs defense vs mischief) and the 'base' form's stats stay byte-identical to today's STAGES baseStats.
Existing stages/evolution tests are ADAPTED (not deleted) and still pass; the one-step tier evolution contract still holds.
`npm test` for shared passes with a higher total than the FEAT-001 baseline; no new runtime dependency added.
verification: Confirm new file packages/shared/src/__tests__/evolution-branching.test.ts exists and its 'every branch reachable' + 'tie deterministic' tests pass.
findings:
DONE. Shared-only change (no package.json / no new deps). Build (npm run build) and tests (npm test) green; shared suite 94 -> 116 passing (+22). Committed on feat/evolution-branching as 55b2722.

FILES CHANGED:
- packages/shared/src/types.ts: added `export type MonsterForm = 'base'|'attack'|'defense'|'mischief'` and OPTIONAL `Monster.form?: MonsterForm`, doc block mirroring affection(#42)/battleRecord(#41).
- packages/shared/src/evolution.ts (NEW): the branch-decision engine. `chooseEvolutionForm(monster, now?=Date.now()): MonsterForm` (pure/deterministic/total), `evolutionFormScores(monster): {attack,defense,mischief}`, and `EVOLUTION_FORM_PRIORITY = ['attack','defense','mischief']`. Put in its own module to avoid an import cycle (stages.ts needs it for predictedNextForm, game.ts for applyEvolution); it only imports battleRecordOf from battle-enhancements plus an inline affection reader (no game.ts/stages.ts back-import).
- packages/shared/src/stages.ts: added `FORM_CONFIG` (per-(tier,variant) baseStats for rookie/champion/ultimate; baby has none), total `formBaseStats(stageId, form): Stats` (falls back to the stage's linear baseStats for 'base'/unknown/baby so base stays byte-identical to pre-#38), and `predictedNextForm(monster, now): MonsterForm|null` (returns chooseEvolutionForm unless at final stage / next tier is baby). evolutionProgress fields untouched.
- packages/shared/src/game.ts: added `formOf` (read-with-default to 'base', clamps unknown/null), `normalizeForm` (new monster w/ form filled, clones stats+careCounters, idempotent, non-mutating), `FORM_DEFAULT='base'`, `isKnownForm`. applyEvolution now threads `now`, calls chooseEvolutionForm on non-baby advances (baby keeps 'base'), persists monster.form, and rebases stats onto formBaseStats(stageId, form) (HP-ratio + max-with-current atk/def behavior unchanged). createMonster seeds `form: 'base'`. validateMonster accepts form absent/undefined/null OR a known variant, rejects present-but-invalid.
- packages/shared/src/index.ts: added `export * from './evolution.ts'`.

BRANCH-DECISION FUNCTION: chooseEvolutionForm. Scores: attack = trainingCount + winRate*10 (winRate = wins/(wins+losses+draws)); defense = careCounters.sleep + feed + clean + affection/10; mischief = hungryLevel + (dirty?4:0) + max(0,(100-affection)/10). Pick max; TIE RULE = fixed priority attack > defense > mischief (iterate EVOLUTION_FORM_PRIORITY, strict `>` so earlier entries win ties). affection defaults to 20 when absent (inline copy of AFFECTION_INITIAL to avoid cycle).

STAT DESIGN (reshape of each tier's linear budget, not strictly stronger): rookie attack{38/13/4} defense{46/8/9} mischief{42/12/3} vs base{40/10/6}; champion attack{66/23/8} defense{80/14/17} mischief{74/21/7} vs base{70/18/12}; ultimate attack{104/36/14} defense{126/22/28} mischief{116/33/12} vs base{110/28/20}. 'base' == STAGES baseStats exactly (asserted byte-identical).

TESTS ADAPTED: packages/shared/src/__tests__/stages.test.ts 'training enough...evolves via train()' now asserts rebased maxHp == formBaseStats('rookie', chosenForm).maxHp and m.form == chosenForm (was `>= rookie baseStats`). packages/shared/src/__tests__/review-fixes.test.ts two tests ('catches up MULTIPLE stages', 'evolves one stage AND rebases') now assert against formBaseStats for the branch the care profile selects (the multi-stage one lands on 'mischief' because 30min offline accrues hunger+dirtiness at evolution time) rather than plain stage baseStats; TIER contract (reaching ultimate/rookie) kept. game.property.test.ts needed NO change (form optional; one-step tier property + stat invariants still hold).

NEW TEST FILE packages/shared/src/__tests__/evolution-branching.test.ts (22 tests) proves: (a-c) each branch reachable (attack for training/win-rate-heavy, defense for rested/fed/clean/affectionate, mischief for neglected); (d) determinism across 50 `now` values + a documented three-way tie resolving to 'attack' and a defense-vs-mischief tie resolving to 'defense'; (e) totality on a zeroed legacy monster (deterministically 'mischief'); (f) formOf defaults legacy to 'base' and clamps unknown/null; (g) normalizeForm fills 'base', idempotent, non-mutating, clones nested; (h) validateMonster accepts absent + each known variant, rejects unknown string / non-string; (i) formBaseStats differs per variant and 'base' byte-identical to stage baseStats, baby+unknown fall back; (j) train()->evolve lands a training/win-heavy monster on 'attack' with attack-variant stats, and a neutrally-raised 'base' stays byte-identical to pre-#38 STAGES baseStats; plus predictedNextForm == chooseEvolutionForm and null at final stage.

NOTE for later features: FEAT-003 (backend chat tone) and FEAT-004 (frontend sprites/StatsPanel/i18n) consume formOf + predictedNextForm; keep JA labels in frontend i18n (shared returns the variant KEY only).
